summary: Iter66 frontend-only verification of 3 new enhancements + WiPay note. ALL PASS. (1) Driver Available Now card renders with animate-pulse Badge whose count matches the pool row count (5 rows == badge 5); accepting the first row shows toast '✅ Order accepted! Head to pickup.', row disappears from pool, badge drops to 4, and the order appears under Active Deliveries as active-order-<id>. Distance tags (available-distance-<id>) were absent — expected, headless GPS denied (per spec: OPTIONAL, not a failure). (2) Admin Wallet Requests pending tab shows the seeded bank deposit proof thumbnail with 'Tap to view proof' (proof-<id>); clicking opens proof-viewer-dialog with proof-viewer-image (base64 src length 118); Esc closes the dialog cleanly. (3) Customer /wallet Deposit dialog renders WiPay 'coming soon' note (wallet-wipay-coming-soon) below the payment buttons: '🇹🇹 WiPay (local bank & card) — coming soon'. Stripe/PayPal buttons were NOT clicked (LIVE-safety respected).

minor.issue: Returns 404 when called directly (path differs from actual route used by DriverDashboard). Not a UI-blocker — dashboard fetches via its own path successfully.

WalletPage.js has multiple dialogs inline; DepositDialog / WithdrawDialog could live in separate files for readability.
